name: Crescent Claw Citadel
introDiscord: A crescent-shaped citadel rises from the reef, its coral battlements sharpened by centuries of tide. Armored Crescent Claw Crabs patrol the walls with the seriousness of soldiers defending the entire Astral Sea.
introTwitch: A crescent-shaped citadel rises from the reef, its coral battlements sharpened by centuries of tide. Armored Crescent Claw Crabs patrol the walls with the seriousness of soldiers defending the entire Astral Sea.

crescent-gate.prompt: A moon-carved gate opens beneath curving battlements. Three approaches lead inward while crab guards inspect shells, shadows, and occasionally each other.

left.message: Shizuki's Crescent balm reads: "Useful after walls attempt diplomacy. Wall won round one. I won the argument."
left.fullHpMessage: The Crescent balm remains unused. You are already at full health, so the wall may keep its narrow victory.

right.message: A Crescent Claw Crab lowers a tiny shell barrier across the path. You step around it. The crab stares at the barrier, stares at you, and takes this personally.

forward.message: A Moonkeeper cache has been incorporated into the fortification as structural support. Removing Star Candies causes absolutely nothing to collapse. Excellent engineering.

talon-arcade.prompt: Talon motifs line an arcade filled with miniature barricades. Every few feet, another crab has constructed a defensive position against something that probably never happened.

left.message: A moon-shell coffer sits behind five increasingly unnecessary barricades. After navigating all five, you discover Star Candies and a sixth barricade inside the coffer.

right.message: Shizuki's cache says: "If guards designed the gate, there is always another hinge. If crabs designed it, there are apparently fourteen."
right.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's fourteen-hinge remedy remains untouched. At full health, you can leave the citadel's engineering problems to the crabs.

forward.message: A Crescent Claw Crab is overseeing construction of a tiny wall. You accidentally approach from the side the wall does not protect. The crab realizes the tactical flaw and blames you.

moonclaw-court.prompt: The inner court is divided by defensive lines, observation posts, and one extremely dramatic empty throne platform. Three routes lead deeper.

left.message: A crab commander points one claw forward. Two smaller crabs immediately retreat. Apparently you have been promoted to 'problem.'

right.message: A Fae offering vessel has been captured and placed beneath guard. The guards are currently distracted fortifying another guard post. You recover Star Candies.

forward.message: One Berry is fixed to a filed shackle pin beside Shizuki's carving: "Their first mistake was teaching me mechanisms. Their second was assuming I'd use them correctly."

boss-antechamber.name: Regent Thronepool
boss-antechamber.prompt: The thronepool fills the citadel's highest court, ringed by crescent battlements and ranks of armored crabs. Every defensive line points toward the massive shell throne at its center.

bossPromptDiscord:
Shell horns sound across the citadel.

Every Crescent Claw guard raises its claws in salute.

From the thronepool, a massive armored crab advances beneath a crescent-shaped crown.

Use /yes to challenge the Regent or /no to make a tactical retreat that the crabs will absolutely call cowardice.
bossPromptTwitch:
Shell horns sound across the citadel.

Every Crescent Claw guard raises its claws in salute.

From the thronepool, a massive armored crab advances beneath a crescent-shaped crown.

Use !yes to challenge the Regent or !no to make a tactical retreat that the crabs will absolutely call cowardice.
bossRetreatText: You make a tactical retreat from Regent Thronepool. Shell horns announce your departure with entirely unnecessary enthusiasm.

boss.revealText: The thronepool erupts as a massive armored crab advances beneath its crescent crown. The Crescent Claw Regent has entered the court!

completionText: The Crescent Claw Regent lowers its claws. Around the court, the other crabs slowly dismantle their barricades... then immediately begin rebuilding them somewhere else. A new route opens beyond the citadel.
